items.headline: Price move coincides with 2 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 4887.97/MWh on 2026-07-02, same day as: BELLARY TPS unit 1: 500.0 MW affected; TORANGALLU TPS unit 3: 300.0 MW affected (~800 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
